name: strad-bundle-api
description: Six pure-API MCP servers packaged as one strad supplementary-image bundle (streamable-HTTP over each server's tool logic: three vendored verbatim in upstream/, slack, google-flights and monarch-money forked in fork/).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=fork/slack --workspace=upstream/serpapi-hotels --workspace=upstream/tailscale --workspace=fork/monarch-money --workspace=upstream/gcs --workspace=fork/google-flights && npm run build --workspace=remote
